connector.name: Navifare MCP
connector.registryDescription: Flight price comparison MCP server. Search multiple booking sources to find better flight prices.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package navifare-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the simonenavifare account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
env.description: Google Gemini API key for image extraction (required)

env.name: NAVIFARE_API_BASE_URL
env.description: Navifare API base URL (optional, defaults to https://api.navifare.com/api/v1/price-discovery/flights)
